articleTitle: A method for personal query based on role preference ontology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: To meet the needs of personal semantic query in information integrated systems, this paper applied role preference ontologies to express the preferences information belonged to different roles. Especially, we focused on self-maintenance of the role preference ontologies. It analyzed the query history of the registered user and calculated the preference weight value of the role preference ontology by using the formula of TF×IDF. The role preference ontology composed of a series of conceptions, sub-conceptions, attributions, instances and their preference weight values. Consequently, the system could return the personal semantic query results according to the preference information of the role preference ontologies.

articleTitle: The research on video supervision technology based on mathematical morphology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper studies some aspects needing to be improved in current video supervision technology. It puts forward video supervision background self-adaptive algorithm in complex environment, by using mathematical morphology, genetic algorithm, rough set theory, etc. We construct morphological structure element according with traffic moving target, and propose mathematical morphology analysis model for traffic video images. At the same time, we study feature extraction based on mathematical morphology and tracking detection methods, and establish typical violation pattern base by utilizing domain expert knowledge.

articleTitle: A discuss of QoS scheme in access network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With the description of the multi-layer switch and qos principle, we introduce the flow classification technology to implement QoS and put the implementation way and workflow. Then we introduce the experiment steps and the result and give related analysis.

articleTitle: Self-reconfiguration robot modeling and topology configurations enumerating
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Topology configuration of a self-reconfigurable robot decided working performance of the robot. Therefore, taking reconfigurable robot which had 2 degree of freedoms (DOFs) and androgynous connect face for example, A new assemble incidence matrix based on graph theorem was defined to establish robot configuration model. Then according to the module symmetry in 3D space and combination principle, all non-isomorphic configurations of 3-module self-reconfigurable robot were solved. At last all configurations of 3-module robot were found and the validity of algorithm was testified by using Matlab software ssimulating.

articleTitle: A note of microelectromechanical systems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: An instability result of a class of microelectro-mechanical systems is given by means of the analysis and computing method.

articleTitle: An efficient document classification algorithm based on kernel LDE
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: To efficiently deal with document classification problem, an efficient document classification algorithm based on kernel local discriminant embedding(kernel LDE) is proposed in this paper. The high-dimensional document data are first mapped into lower-dimensional feature space, then the SVM classifier is applied to classify documents. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves much better performance than other traditional document classification algorithms.

articleTitle: Retrieval oriented robust image hashing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to improve the validity and veracity of image retrieval, an image hashing algorithm based on fractional Fourier transform (FRFT) for content-based image retrieval (CBIR) application is proposed in this paper. By employing FRFT and normalized Hamming distance, a robust hashing sequence is obtained by preprocessing, feature generation and post processing. The orders of FRFT are used as the encryption keys. For illustration, several benchmark images are utilized to show the feasibility of the image hashing algorithm. Experimental results show that the proposed scheme is robust against common image processing such as JPEG compression, mid-filtering, and rotation. Therefore, the scheme proposed in this paper is suitable for CBIR application.

articleTitle: Weight analysis of brassiere-wearing Influence Factors Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The brassiere-wearing effect is produced by the combined action of body shape and brassiere. The process is so complicated that it is an issue for people to realize what functions the different factors perform in the change of bust appearance. In this research, an artificial neural network model was applied, in which the input neurons contained 11 possible factors including body measurements and brassiere configuration data. The model consisted of 6 BP neural networks. Each of them could simulate and predict one effect parameter respectively. Based on them, the sensitivity analysis was adopted to achieve the weight distributions of the influence factors for each of the effect parameters. Through the weight analysis, the influence of all the factors in brassiere-wearing became clear. The result would help fashion designers to design brassiere pertinently, according to the individual body shape and special need of wearing effect.

articleTitle: Identifying the task dependence in computer supported large scale collaborative manufacturing via E-CARGO model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Task dependence identification will benefit collaborative manufacturing in reducing the process coordination and materials or semi-manufactured product transfer delay between different process steps. However, in large scale collaborative manufacturing, it is hard to determine the task dependence as there are multiple products and lots process steps should be done for each product. This paper presents yet a new method to identify the task dependence in computer aided collaborative manufacturing through E-CARGO model. Process steps and product are described in the model and the relationship between different process steps can be easily identified. A case study is demonstrated for the adoption of this method.

articleTitle: Risk analysis for explosion and burning of compressed natural gas (CNG) station vehicles exclusively
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The adjustment of county's energy strategy, environment protect requirement and the continuous progress of the automobile technology, more and more automobiles were designed on the CNG as their fuel and corresponding CNG stations were increasing at the same time. But the consequential accident such as the leakage of the gas and the fire disaster made the security of the CNG station became a serious problem a problem which people pay more and more attention on it. if the gas was not fired immediately it may construct the gas cloud cluster and will explode when it comes out a fire, and people in a certain distance may wounded by the shockwave also the architectures in the dangerous range will be destroyed. This paper will contribute to formulate the evacuate conditions for pedestrian after the explode accident happening and also will provide the basis for evaluating the new constructed CNG stations.

articleTitle: Research and application of multiple attribute decision making based on triangular fuzzy ideal points
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In multiple attribute decision making, attribute value and attribute weight cann't be often given the exact value, they are sometimes given in the form of fuzzy numbers. This paper researches a kind of multiple attribute decision making in which the attribute value and attribute weight are given in the form of triangular fuzzy numbers, proposes a new decision making method, defines the positive and negative ideal alternatives of triangle fuzzy number, as well as the distance between the various alternatives and the positive, negative ideal alternatives, through calculates the nearness degrees between various alternatives and ideal alternative to carry on sorting the alternatives. Finally, this method is applied in choosing investment alternatives to develop new product, the example shows that this method is validity and feasibility.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of network set-top box
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With the rapidly development of digital video broadcasting business and Ethernet network, more and more business and users attach great importance to Internet set-top boxes and interrelated software and hardware, the business is developing rapidly for Internet video-on-demand and live broadcast. In order to meet the demand of the people through the TV to watch video in Ethernet rich resources, and realized the functions of network video-on-demand and online viewing to net videos. A type of network set-top box is designed through the methods of IP network, the resource of network video frequency can watch the using the terminal end of TV. The design achieve the desired effectiveness, and researching results research up good application prospects in future.

articleTitle: A calculating and verifying system for PCM electromagnetism characteristic
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In the face of the economic crisis, every enterprise has to reduce the producing cost. In CRT, PCM (Purity Convergency Magnet) is a very important component. The electromagnetism characteristic of PCM is one of the most important working performances. it is also the key to assure the quality of the PCM. So how to calculate and verify the PCM electromagnetism characteristic before producing become more and more important for the CRT enterprise. In this paper, according to the working principals of the ferromagnetic element in CRT, it deduces the formula of the PCM electromagnetism characteristic, and setups the mathematics model. At the end the PCM Electromagnetism Characteristic Calculating and Verifying System (PCMe System) is developed and applied to the enterprise. The experiment result shows that PCMe System can calculate and verify the electromagnetism characteristic of PCM.

articleTitle: Automation testing process modeling method of SOA-based isomerous software
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: On the basis of SOA-based isomerous software integration and automation testing technique, took testing specification as centre, analyzed with the mainstream testing model and dependency relation and applied with extraction technology, a new automation testing process model of SOA-based isomerous software was proposed. It covered the whole testing process including test plan, test design, test case generation, test execution, test results analysis and retesting, etc. These activities were merged into the process of software development. The model has implemented the conformity of the different testing model.

articleTitle: OWC-LOWA operator and its application to risk investment in uncertain linguistic setting
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With respect to multiple attribute decision making (MADM) problems in which the attribute weights take the form of real numbers, and the preference values take the form of uncertain linguistic variables, a new decision making analysis method is developed. By utilizing some operational laws of linguistic variables, we propose a new aggregation operators called ordered weighting C-LOWA (OWC-LOWA) operator based on the continuous LOWA operator(C-LOWA) and then develop an OWC-LOWA operator-based approach to MADM in uncertain linguistic setting. The approach is simple and don't need the comparison between two uncertain linguistic variables. Finally, an illustrative example about risk investment is given to verify the developed approach and to demonstrate its practicality and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Chaos analysis of the influence of tensile stress on electrochemical noise
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, chaos theory was used to analyze the influence of tensile stress on electrochemical noise about 7075-T76 aluminum alloy in 3.5%NaCl solutions. The result shows that the applied stress accelerated the formation of electric double-layer and the greater the stress, the shorter the formation time. Electrochemical noise data in the phase had strong linear autocorrelation whose largest lyapunov exponents were negative. Electrochemical noise data was not chaotic. The greater the stress, the larger the largest LE and the steady trend. After the formation of electric double-layer, electrochemical noise data in the phase had weak linear autocorrelation. With the increasing of the stress, largest lyapunov exponents were smaller whose range were (0 1). Electrochemical noise data had weak chaos and periodicity. Fractal dimension of electrochemical noise in the phase had the same change trend with largest lyapunov exponents. The stress can lead to stabilization of electrochemical signals and decrease fluctuation.

articleTitle: Resource evaluating for networked manufacturing based on fuzzy AHP
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In view that current resource evaluating for networked manufacturing is inefficient, this thesis carries systematic research to this question, including selecting process model, evaluating indexes and algorithm. A multi-stage resource selecting process model and a multi-level resource evaluating indexes for networked manufacturing are established. A resource evaluating algorithm for networked manufacturing based on fuzzy AHP is proposed. According to different type indexes, degree of membership function is defined. Finally, atypical simulation study was carried out to illustrate its validity.

articleTitle: S&T text ming and visualization applied on enterprise's r&d:A case study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Much effort has been done to develop more objective quantitative methods to analyze and integrate science and technology information for understanding research trends and research structures. Science & Technology (S&T) text mining is the application of text mining to highly detailed technical material. Co-word analysis is one class of techniques that exploits the use of co-occurrences of items in science and technology text. Bibliometrics and co-word analyses methods were applied on research literature of science and technology of Boeing Co. Its knowledge domains and structures were visualized by network tools.

articleTitle: Research of intelligence control based on Library-similar Knowledge-increasable Neural Network Group
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Aiming at the complex dynamic feature of large ship, an intelligent control structure based on library-similar knowledge-increasable neural network group is presented. This compounded control structure using the dynamic knowledge increasable learning capability of the neural network groups, solve the problems of online identification and online design of the controller, so that the high precise output tracking control of uncertain nonlinear large ship can be realized. Simulating results show that it is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: The application of data communication between VxWorks and Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Real-time data communication in the real-time operating system by Ethernet is an ideal application in industry. This paper analyses the feature of embedded realtime operating system VxWorks and AT91RM9200, also introduces the design of the hardware interface circuit and flow of software programming in general. The general process of the application between Ethernet and VxWorks in this paper can be referred by other application of Ethernet in the real-time operating system.

articleTitle: Effect of return intervals on singular spectrum of financial time series
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Many natural records exhibit multifractality characterized by the width and maximum of the singular spectrum. This paper study, how the return intervals of the Hang Seng Index affects the characteristic of the spectral function. We find that the multifractality of the financial time series is similar to the property of the return intervals obtained by small threshold q. Although the multifractality can be found in the financial time series and return interval series obtained by different threshold q, we can't ignore that the characteristic of the return intervals with moderate threshold q become stronger.

articleTitle: United grey system-neural network model and its application in prediction of groundwater level
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: At present, classic methods are often used to predict groundwater level, but the result is not ideal. Though GM(1,1) and neural network are applied in this field, some limits have been existed. In view of the difficulty to predict groundwater level, in this paper, a grey system-neural network united model is developed based on the grey theory and neural network method. It predicts various tendency of groundwater in this area in the future. Case study indicates that precision of the model is rather high and its popularization significance is better than the other models, and has some practical value when being used in the dynamic groundwater level analysis.

articleTitle: Development of mine microseism monitoring 3D visualization system based on OpenGL
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the current mine microseism monitoring data visualization, develop a 3D visualization system based on the OPENGL program language. Establish a mine microseism monitoring 3D model. Dynamic displays monitoring points and the microseism centre which is got by the monitoring data computing in the 3D model. It implements the purpose of the monitoring data 3D visualization. For the application of the system, designs the model interactive operation of the slice, rotating, scaling, etc. It increases the displaying speed of the microseism monitoring data and enhances the abilities of forecasting microseism calamities.

articleTitle: Research on dispatching model of inter-basin diversion project based on multi-intelligent agents
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Today, the disproportional distribution of water resources becomes a restrictive factor for sustainable development of Chinese national economy. Therefore, Chinese government has implemented numerous Inter-basin water diversion projects. However they are complicated and systemic engineering projects which consist of many facilities with longer delivery route, involutedly transit area and multitudinous impact factors. This paper studies the management model of inter-basin water diversion based on multi-intelligent agents which regards the management department of facility as agent and takes its goals and function demands into account. First, the paper studies the water delivery framework of distributed inter-basin water diversion project, and analyzes the types and distribution of the intelligent agent and model of communication, interaction and cooperation so that automation, convenient and intelligence of inter-basin water diversion can be realized. Then, it researches the inner structures of all kinds of intelligent agents, and discusses simultaneously the mechanism of knowledge expression and self-training.

articleTitle: Algorithm study of multiple-depot vehicle routing problem based on fuzzy simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, the multiple-depot vehicle routing problem with fuzzy demands is considered, on the basis of uncertain demand of multiple-depot vehicle routing problem, a fuzzy chance constrained program is designed based on fuzzy credibility theory. Then the hybrid genetic algorithm based on fuzzy simulation is used to solve the vehicle routing model. In genetic algorithm, a new code is given, and introduce an evolution method that combining evolution of same depot vehicle and different depot vehicle, in order to avoid local constringency and get general optimization. The results of experiment indicated that the algorithm can effectively solve the fuzzy vehicle routing problem.

articleTitle: Body surface representation using adjustable template model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The paper presents a template modeler for modeling individualization, realistic body surface. A new body shape is easily generated by modifying a template model with some dressing parameters. The problem is approached by some fitted silhouettes that are devoted to the generation of appropriate shape and proportion of the body geometry with inputting the parameters. These silhouettes are simulated with relative parameters. We obtain the correspondence by fitting a template onto each inputted data. Throughout the paper, the body surface is represented by the corresponding joint parameters, which will determine the linear approximation of the physique. Having these parameters modeled, the runtime modeling can be reduced to the template model. It demonstrates that it is simple and flexible to generate an individualized body surface model by applying different dressing parameters.

articleTitle: CAE of outer characteristic of telescopic shock absorber for three wheel agricultural vehicle
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: According to the thickness and pre-deformation of throttle slice, and the throttle area, the velocity points at which the throttle valve opens firstly and maximum were researched and their mathematic model were given. Based on this, the model of piecewise linear math function of outer characteristic simulation was established with the formula of throttle slice deformation and the relation of throttle pressure to oil flux. The CAE software of outer characteristic of shock absorber of Telescopic Shock Absorber for three wheel agricultural vehicle was developed. A practical example of simulation was given, and the performance test was conducted for to verify the CAE software. The results show that the CAE software is reliable, and the values simulated is close to that tested.

articleTitle: The application research on the production control of dilute acid delinting
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper focused on the existent technology problems in the dilute acid delinting of cotton seed, it first introduced the traditional process of dilute acid delinting, then combined with the automatic control technology and information processing technology of the controling of concentration, temperature and so on during the production process, rebuilt the production process and advanced the framework model about the production control management system of the dilute acid delinting. Practice has proved that such dilute acid delinting technology with automatic control and information processing can effectively improve the quality of cotton seed processing. Production control system, dilute acid delinting of cotton seed, automatic control

articleTitle: The linkage between entrepreneurial intensity and firm performance: The evidence from China's SMEs
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Entrepreneurial intensity is the extent to which any one event is innovative, risky, and proactive, and frequency of entrepreneurship, which refer to number of times organizations act entrepreneurially. Entrepreneurial strategy plays a important role on performance of China's small and medium size enterprises (SMEs). This study tried to test the relationship between entrepreneurial intensity and firm performance. We collect data from 123 firms in Jilin province. The result of our test implied that entrepreneurial intensity is positive related with firm's financial and non-financial performance. The discussion and conclusion will be given at the end of this paper.

articleTitle: Two-phase flow parameters measurement and Gauss-Newton image reconstruction algorithm for Electrical Capacitance Tomography
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: To solve the problem of two-phase flow measurement for electrode electrical capacitance tomography (ECT), on the basis of analyzing ECT system measurement principle, we constructed the mathematical model of two-phase flow distribution information according to double integral infinitesimal principle, and formed a set of 12-electrode two-phase ECT system. And to speed up the slow convergence rate of ordinary iteration method, a Gauss-Newton algorithm is improved on the basis of analyzing mechanism of the algorithm, and the feasibility of using this algorithm for ECT problems is discussed. It shows that it is easy to meet the convergence condition and error of image reconstruction is small. Experimental results and simulation data indicate that the algorithm can provide high quality images and favorable stabilization compared with LBP, Landweber and conjugate gradient algorithms and this new algorithm presents a feasible and effective way to research the image reconstruction algorithm for the Electrical Capacitance Tomography System.

articleTitle: Plasma etching process monitoring with optical emission spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Stringent process control become an issue of growing importance in the integrated circuits manufacture. The in-suit monitoring and endpoint detection of very deep submicron meter size polysilicon gate etching is critical to the proper control of plasma etching. Process faults should be detected and corrected before the parts in etching tools are damaged. Real time monitoring with optical emission spectroscopy (OES) would allow for simultaneous correction, and OES endpoint detection is a most important means to end etching process. This paper discussed the plasma etching process control with OES, the PCA data reduction technique is used to compress the real time OES data, and endpoint detection algorithms which is used to trigger endpoint for etching process is investigated.

articleTitle: Stress distribution of thin circular quartz qafer and force sensitive characteristic experiments of resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: An ANSYS analysis and computation of the stress distribution in circular AT cut quartz wafer was carried out, when quartz wafer was subjected to a force along its diameter which was parallel to the x axis, the force-frequency coefficient of quartz resonator were tested by using plated electrode on different region. Experiment proves that the result of ANSYS analysis is nearly consistent with experiment, and the maximum error is 0.36%. Therefore, when a resonator is designed on the same circular quartz, by using the finite element method, electrode may be set at the limited scope to choose positions of the notable force-frequency coefficient according to the stress distribution of the wafer. The integrated quartz resonator of the prominent force-frequency coefficient can be obtained.

articleTitle: A new testing method for high-frequency power wave trapper measurement based on correlation theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The composing of high-frequency power wave trapper were introduced in this article, and a new method based on traditional correlation theory is presented in the test system. Cross-correlation functions of the two measured signals are directly computed and some properties about correlation and sine function are adopted to separate the part noise and useful signal, so the measurement accuracy are improved. The Matlab is adopted in the typical model bandwidth power wave trapper coil circuit to calculate and to simulate, and the validity and the accuracy of this method are discussed. The conclusions are supported by the results. Primary chart of systemic configurable design is drawn as a model to make apparatuses for wave trapper measurement.

articleTitle: Application of moving windows autoregressive quadratic model in runoff forecast
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper describes a novel method to mid-long term runoff prediction using moving windows autoregressive quadratic model which combines autoregressive quadratic model and moving windows method to improve prediction capability of natural runoff. The parameters of the model are determined in light of the joints of half-sine function, self-adaptive optimization, smoothly moving windows and generalized likelihood uncertainty estimation. The application shows that the model can not only improve prediction capability but keep robust, and shows that the model has simpler structure and less parameter than artificial neural networks model, and avoids locally minimal point and excess study, etc. Therefore, the moving windows autoregressive quadratic model is a promising tool for mid-long term runoff forecast.

articleTitle: The corner detection for a mobile robot of power lines
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper put forwards a corner detection solution and develops and builds a vision system depending upon the TMS320DM642 as the core, which can realize the image collection and display, implement the corner detection algorithm. Through the extended UART interfaces, this system can communicate with mobile robots of power lines. Corner coordinates obtained from the algorithm of this system can be used for extraction and matching of the image feature points, motion estimation, three-dimensional reconstruction, etc. Compared to the traditional vision system based on image capturing cards and PC platforms, it has the advantages of small size, favourable real-time properties, low power consumption, etc. Experiment results indicate that the precision and speed of corner extraction are both better than those of the traditional PC platforms.

articleTitle: A method to support auto adaptive access network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Access network is the last mile of the network, so there are different access ways. How to effectively recognize the access end station and manage them is the hot pot in research field. This paper discusses a novel auto adaptive access network method and gives the system software structure.

articleTitle: Development of a computer-aided decision support system for timber harvesting operations in forestry industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A user-friendly timber simulation program was developed by using object oriented programming technique. The component object model (COM) was used to design and implement the program. Three major modules were included in the harvesting simulation system: RUN, ANALYSIS, and REPORT. Input to the system includes species composition, stand density, spatial pattern, felling machine and cutting method for the felling simulation, and extraction machine and extraction pattern for the extraction simulation. Output is either a 2-dimensional or 3-dimensional stand map that lists species, DBH, spatial location, and total height for each individual tree and a harvested site together with all operation data saved to the relational database. The decision support system for timber harvesting operations could aid forest managers to examine the harvesting techniques and interactions among stand, harvest, and machines in terms of production, cost, and traffic intensity. It is a useful tool for decision-making in harvesting operation management.

articleTitle: Discuss of VLAN-IP technology in embedded system
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The appearance of layer-3 or upper layer switch, can solve the problems of low forward rate, high delay of traffic that needs to cross networks. so how to implement VLAN-IP in network device with embedded system is a hot problem. This paper will introduces layer-3 principle, character and implementation in embedded system..

articleTitle: Mathematical model and its self-learning algorithm for hot strip laminar cooling
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: During the process of the strip cooling after finished rolling, the mathematical model of hot rolled strip coiling temperature is very important for obtaining satisfactory microstructure performance and mechanical property of the hot strip. The outdated and the advanced mathematical models of coiling temperature are presented in the paper, and self-learning of online control strategy based on the advanced mathematical model is analyzed. Finally, the measured data based on the advanced model is analyzed.

articleTitle: Non-fragile guaranteed cost robust control for discrete uncertain nonlinear systems with time delay
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: To a class of uncertain nonlinear discrete time delay systems, this paper considers the problem of non-fragile guaranteed-cost H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">infin</sub> controller design method. First, based on the stability criterion and linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) theory, a sufficient condition of the existence of the non-fragile guaranteed-cost H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">infin</sub> controller is established. Then the problem of control is solved via a robust controller with gain additive and multiplicative perturbations, the designed controller guarantees that the closed-loop system is regular, impulse free and asymptotically stable for all admissible uncertainties and nonlinear element, and satisfies a cost bound, more over, also satisfies H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">infin</sub> performance index. A numerical example demonstrates that the systems are robust and the design method is effective.

articleTitle: The model of target classification and taxis based on the analysis of grey relevancy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: One fundamental issue is target classification and taxis in selecting and striking target, which is the crucial link of combined firepower strike. It is the core problem of winning the victory of combined operation to how to grade the target system. This paper establishes the model of target classification and taxis by using the methodologies of grey decision-making and grey relevancy, and an example is given to validate the model.

Author Keywords: the analysis methodology of grey relevancy

articleTitle: Model for Selecting an ERP system based on IIFWA operator under interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With respect to multiple attribute decision making problems with interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy information, some operational laws of interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy numbers, score function and accuracy function of interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy numbers are introduced. We utilize the interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy weighted averaging (IIFWA) operator to aggregate the interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy information corresponding to each alternative, and then rank the alternatives and select the most desirable one(s) according to the score function and accuracy function. Finally, an illustrative example about selecting an ERP system is given to verify the developed approach and to demonstrate its practicality and effectiveness.

Author Keywords: interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy weighted averaging (IIFWA) operator

articleTitle: Correction of signal induced noise for Photo-Multiplier Tube
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Photo-Multiplier Tube is the key of photoelectric conversion subsystem of light detecting and ranging. When it is exposed in an intensive light, the response of PMT systems becomes nonlinear, that is, the output count rate is no longer proportional to the incident light intensity. A nonlinear effects caused by the intensive light are analyzed in this paper and the errors induced by the nonlinear effects are measured. According to these measurements, two different corrections of these nonlinear effects are proposed and the result of correction is reasonable. This electronic document is a “live” template. articleTitle: Study on Personalized Service Technology Based on Deep Web Database
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With the development of personalized service technology, analyze the status of deep Web database and personalized service, put forward one new method of personalized service according to user behavior currently in deep Web database, discuss the key technology. The experiment shows the system can conquer the limitation of personalized service too depend on the user behavior.

articleTitle: Research on active control of diesel engine based on wavelet neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The vibration of diesel engine transmitting mainly from base to outside, the double-layer isolation vibration system of diesel engine was simplified into a double-freedom spring-mass systematic model. The vibration of diesel engine transmission upon the base tending to zero, the optimum control force was imposed on the middle-mass by the vibration signal of the middle-mass of the trend toward zero and characteristics of wavelet and neural network, from which active control model was obtained based on wavelet neural network system. The model is applied to the double-layer isolation vibration of diesel engine isolating effectively the transmission of low-frequency vibration to the base and compensating the shortcomings of passive double-layer vibration systems, which expands frequency-band of isolation vibration of diesel engine on passive isolation vibration until the vertical speed of the middle-mass within the allowable value range. It can achieve the purposes of isolation and reduction vibration and active control and guides the design and test of self-adaptive active control by the method.

articleTitle: Research on road tunnel fire state and correlative preventing measure
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: It is believed that the excessive multifarious preventing measures are useless in tunnel. In this paper, depending on the analyses on the fire classification of tunnel the development law of different fire airflow, some correlative preventing measures are proposed by the requirements of currently road tunnel. They includes the requirements of aeration wind speed, the setting of vent of smoke, the arrangement requirements of fire preventing subarea, and the necessity of adoption of special fireproofing material. At last, some simulations of the fire smoke expand laws are given. All of these prove that our studies are effective to design and construction of the road tunnel.
